topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, links the material to prior histopathology practicals, and outlines the goals of the session.

topics.label: Tumor Virology, Cellular Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and experimental assays for measuring cellular transformation.

topics.label: Characteristics and Mutational Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated genes and illustrate their mutational effects using cell cycle regulators such as Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular origins and cellular outcomes of sequence and chromosomal instability, detailing defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic segregation.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential mutational accumulation and inherited genetic predispositions drive the rate, progression, and evolution of malignancies.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by answering questions, recommending reading material, and previewing the upcoming lecture.
